description: Engineering real-time object-detection and image-enhancement pipelines for satellite imagery under SAC-ISRO's geospatial AI/ML initiatives.
highlights: Engineered real-time object-detection pipelines for satellite imagery using multiple YOLO variants (YOLOv8, YOLOv11, YOLOv26), Faster R-CNN, and RNN-based sequence models in Python, PyTorch, and OpenCV.
Researched and prototyped Dragon Hatchling (BDH) and Mamba-based architectures to improve the efficiency of large-scale satellite image analysis.
Built image-denoising and enhancement modules to remove noise from real-time satellite data, improving downstream model accuracy.
Performed image preprocessing and annotation (Roboflow, LabelImg) on remote-sensing datasets to support high-quality model training.
Collaborated with cross-functional research teams on geospatial and AI/ML initiatives under SAC-ISRO.
